race.comment: ATTRACTIVENESS (5) exciting mare who can keep the winning momentum going with Grima's 2kg claim. Closed strongly from the inside draw for a dominant win over 1400m at this track in Midway class. Tackles a stronger contest and will have little trouble over the 1500m. Go close. CUBAN CIGAR (1) held in high regard by the Bartley yard and indicated he was in for a good prep after scoring a solid first-up victory over 1300m at Wyong. Stretches out to this trip for the first time and will be strong late. Leading contender. JONSON (7) coming along well on the provincial circuit winning his last two starts in easier grade. Six weeks between runs heading into this and not to be underestimated. DANISH PRINCE (6) proven at this level and strips fitter third up with Fitzgerald's 3kg claim. Will roll forward and give plenty of cheek over his preferred trip. SO REBELLIOUS (8) tough win third up and stays in the mix.
